name: Liquid-Cooling Distribution Unit ACDU
full_description: The Liquid-Cooling Distribution Unit ACDU is designed for data center cooling systems that require location-independent deployment and compressor-free natural cooling. According to Accessen, the solution lowers overall system PUE, uses intelligent controls with variable-speed pumping and hydraulic flow modulation, and reduces installation complexity through modular prefabrication.

technical_parameters.Secondary Side Coolant: Deionized Water/ Ethylene Glycol/ Propylene Glycol/ Fluorinated Fluids

details.title: What is the ACDU used for?
details.content: Accessen positions the ACDU as a liquid-cooling distribution unit for data centers, where it supports compressor-free natural cooling and helps reduce overall PUE in liquid cooling systems.

details.title: How is deployment simplified?
details.content: The product uses a prefabricated modular design that minimizes installation complexity on site and supports faster project delivery.

seo_data.meta_description: Prefabricated data center liquid-cooling distribution unit with adaptive control, natural cooling, and rapid deployment features.
